summary: The 2026 LLM landscape is dominated by a handful of frontier families — OpenAI's GPT line, Anthropic's Claude, Google's Gemini, and Meta's Llama — with cost-efficient open-weight challengers like DeepSeek, Qwen, and Mistral gaining rapid developer adoption. Enterprise consumption is increasingly routed through cloud aggregators (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, IBM watsonx), which significantly amplifies the real-world reach of models available on those platforms. Prices continue to fall sharply, with open-weight reasoning models now delivering near-frontier performance at a fraction of the cost.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Highest API call volume and broadest developer adoption, available directly and via Azure OpenAI, giving it dominant enterprise aggregator reach.
models.best_for: General-purpose production applications and multimodal assistants

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Shipped February 17, 2026 matching Opus-level performance at Sonnet pricing; widely used for coding and available on AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex.
models.best_for: Agentic coding and enterprise development workflows

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: The context-window leader with deep Google Cloud / Vertex AI integration, driving strong enterprise adoption.
models.best_for: Long-document analysis and large-context enterprise tasks

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: High-volume, low-cost workhorse with a large context window, heavily used for scalable production workloads through Vertex AI.

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: 671B-parameter MoE reasoning model cited as the cheapest frontier-class model ($0.55/$2.19 per 1M tokens), driving massive open-weight adoption and HuggingFace downloads.

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: Popular open-weight general-purpose MoE model widely downloaded on HuggingFace and used as a low-cost alternative to proprietary frontier models.
models.best_for: General-purpose chat and cost-efficient self-hosted applications

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: Among the most downloaded open-weight models on HuggingFace and widely available across AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI for self-hosted and fine-tuned deployments.
models.best_for: Customizable self-hosted and fine-tuned enterprise deployments

models.name: o3
models.popularity_notes: OpenAI's flagship reasoning model with strong adoption for complex problem-solving, available via OpenAI API and Azure OpenAI.
models.best_for: Complex reasoning, math, and scientific problem-solving

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: Fast, low-cost Claude variant with strong adoption for high-volume tasks, available across AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI.

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: Leading open-weight MoE model from Alibaba with strong HuggingFace download numbers and growing adoption in open-source and self-hosted deployments.

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: Widely adopted European frontier model available on AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI, popular for enterprise and sovereign-cloud deployments.
